infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: T-Matrix Track uses your location during active work trips to accurately record technician route waypoints and trip distances.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: T-Matrix Track requires continuous location access during active trips to sync route milestones with your dispatch system even while your phone is locked or in your pocket.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: T-Matrix Track requires background location access during active trips to log travel routes without interrupting your work.
